summary: Russia launched a massive overnight drone wave of 267 Shahed-type UAVs from multiple directions including Kursk, Orel, Millerovo, Primorsko-Akhtarsk, occupied Donetsk and Crimea, with Ukrainian air defenses claiming 233 intercepted. Russian strikes hit a Kyiv logistics center storing Flamingo UAV components and a Fire Point warehouse with FP-1/FP-2 drone parts, while a separate attack destroyed the Epicenter hypermarket in Zaporizhzhia. Ukrainian forces reportedly struck a Tu-95MS strategic bomber at Engels airbase using SBU Alpha operatives.

sections.executive_summary: Russia executed its largest drone barrage of the war with 267 Shahed/Geran UAVs launched from six directions, overwhelming Ukrainian air defenses which claimed 233 interceptions but acknowledged hits on 15 locations. Simultaneous Russian strikes degraded Kyiv's drone logistics infrastructure while Ukrainian special operations hit a strategic Tu-95MS bomber at Engels, demonstrating deep-strike capability. Critical retail warehousing destruction (90%) and mobilization shortfalls (30k/month needed) compound Ukraine's strategic strain.

points: Ukrainian air defenses engaged 267 Shahed/Geran drones plus an Onyx missile and Iskander-M ballistic missile launched from Kursk, Orel, Millerovo, Primorsko-Akhtarsk, occupied Donetsk and Crimea, claiming 233 interceptions across northern, southern, eastern, and central Ukraine with hits confirmed at 15 locations. (Source: @kpszsu/75160)

SBU Alpha operatives conducted a successful strike on a Tu-95MS strategic bomber at Engels airbase in Saratov region, Russia, per Zelensky's announcement; this aircraft type regularly launches cruise missiles at Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/83744)

Agrarian Policy Minister Taras Vysotsky reported approximately 90% of retail chain warehouse infrastructure destroyed by Russian strikes, necessitating major logistics restructuring that will increase delivery costs, complexity, and time while reducing product selection. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32829)

GUR Chief Budanov stated Ukraine requires a minimum of 30,000 newly mobilized personnel per month to maintain current force levels, calling this the absolute floor for sustaining the Armed Forces. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32830)
A large prisoner-of-war exchange is being prepared for the coming days, according to Budanov speaking on the national telethon. (Source: @UkraineNow/83752)
The Cabinet approved an experimental two-year project for underground fuel storage during martial law to enhance energy security. (Source: @UkraineNow/83750)

Prime Minister Koretsky condemned the repeated ammunition depot explosions near Bucha as "criminal negligence" in the fifth year of war, demanding immediate law enforcement action and strict punishment. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32839)

Russian forces launched a record 267 Shahed-type strike UAVs (including jet-powered Geran-4/5 variants), one Onyx anti-ship missile, and one Iskander-M ballistic missile from Crimea overnight, targeting locations across Ukraine from multiple axes: Kursk, Orel, Millerovo, Primorsko-Akhtarsk, occupied Donetsk, and occupied Crimea. (Source: @kpszsu/75160)

Russian MoD claimed destruction of Kyiv's Fim Service logistics center storing Flamingo UAV components and Fire Point warehouse containing FP-1/FP-2 drone starter accelerators and components, asserting these supported Ukrainian UAV operations. (Source: @tass_agency/392558)
Russian air defenses reportedly shot down 313 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions, the Azov Sea, and Black Sea waters overnight, per MoD statement. (Source: @tass_agency/392549)
Russian strikes hit the Epicenter hypermarket in Zaporizhzhia and the Karavan shopping center in Kharkiv (closed at time), per Ukrainian sources. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32832, @ukr_leaks_eng/32824)

Russian attacks on Sevastopol killed one and wounded three; a drone attack on Rostov region injured seven including four hospitalized (two adults, two children, one child critical). (Source: @tass_agency/392559, @tass_agency/392560)
Russian MoD reported striking Nikolaev port's marine transshipment terminal, logistics centers, and 18 military-purpose storage facilities. (Source: @tass_agency/392557)

Zelensky warned that Russia plans to significantly scale up ballistic missile production, urging stronger sanctions from key global jurisdictions to counter this expansion. (Source: @UkraineNow/83749)
Russian aviation conducted KAB guided bomb strikes on eastern Kharkiv region and Donetsk region, per Ukrainian military monitoring channels. (Source: @kpszsu/75133, @kpszsu/75180)

Jet-powered Shahed/Geran-4/5 drones launched from Donetsk airport (occupied territory) targeted northern Dnipropetrovsk region, with new groups of reactive UAVs crossing the front line. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72094, @eRadarrua/108236)

Russian strike UAVs (both reactive and impact types) were tracked over Donetsk region (1 group), Dnipropetrovsk region (2 impact + 2 reactive groups), and Zaporizhzhia region (2 impact groups). (Source: @eRadarrua/108284)
Sumy region faced 2 groups of impact UAVs, indicating continued pressure on the northeastern border area. (Source: @eRadarrua/108284)
Kharkiv region shopping center Karavan struck by drone; facility was closed with no civilians present. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32824)
Zaporizhzhia's Epicenter hypermarket destroyed by Russian air strike, per published imagery. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32832)
Russian KAB strikes continue on Donetsk region and eastern Kharkiv region as part of sustained aerial bombardment campaign. (Source: @kpszsu/75133)

Multiple jet-powered Shahed/Geran drones launched from Orel training ground (Orel-Pivdenny) in Russia's Orel region, tracked toward Chernihiv and Kyiv regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72091, @mon1tor_ua/72106)
Reactive UAVs launched from Bryansk region (Russia) toward Chernihiv region, with one drone reportedly crossing into Belarus airspace near Gomel. (Source: @eRadarrua/108215, @mon1tor_ua/72096)

Chernihiv region experienced multiple drone ingress routes: via Baturin and Kipti from Bryansk, past Slavutych toward Borzna, and toward Kyiv along reservoir. (Source: @eRadarrua/108215, @eRadarrua/108219, @eRadarrua/108278)

Kyiv region faced intensive drone activity: reactive UAVs over Kyiv city, Kyiv reservoir area, Semipolki, Holianivka, Boryspil direction, Brovary, Rzhyshchiv, Ukrainka, Myronivka, Kaharlyk, Yagotin, Obukhiv, Vasylkiv, Hlevakha, Kalynivka. (Source: @kpszsu/75150, @eRadarrua/108286, @mon1tor_ua/72110, @mon1tor_ua/72104, @eRadarrua/108256, @eRadarrua/108271)

Cherkasy region targeted by drones transiting Poltava region (past Semenivka) and directly from Drabiv, with threats to Kaniv and onward to Kyiv. (Source: @eRadarrua/108215, @eRadarrua/108216, @eRadarrua/108221, @eRadarrua/108281)
Poltava region saw rapid target engagement in direction of Poltava city, with drones transiting toward Cherkasy and Kyiv. (Source: @kpszsu/75172, @eRadarrua/108221)
Kyiv-Zhytomyr highway (M-06, 15-32km) closed in both directions due to large-scale fire from Russian attacks, per patrol police. (Source: @UkraineNow/83758)
Russian strikes hit Nikolaev port's marine transshipment terminal, logistics centers, and 18 military-purpose storage facilities, per Russian MoD. (Source: @tass_agency/392557)
Zaporizhzhia region faced 2 groups of impact UAVs and the Epicenter hypermarket was destroyed by Russian air strike. (Source: @eRadarrua/108284, @ukr_leaks_eng/32832)
Jet-powered Shahed/Geran drones launched from occupied territory toward Kirovohrad region from Mykolaiv region direction. (Source: @kpszsu/75180)
Kirovohrad region tracked 1 group of reactive UAVs; Dnipropetrovsk region tracked 2 impact and 2 reactive groups. (Source: @eRadarrua/108284)
Sevastopol attack resulted in 1 killed and 3 wounded, per local authorities. (Source: @tass_agency/392559)
Russian drone launches from Primorsko-Akhtarsk (Krasnodar region) and occupied Crimea contributed to the massive overnight wave. (Source: @kpszsu/75160)
No specific ground maneuver updates for southern front in current messages.

Jet-powered Geran-4/5 variants (reactive Shaheds) prominently used, launched from Orel training ground, Donetsk airport, and potentially other sites, demonstrating increased speed and maneuverability. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72091, @mon1tor_ua/72106, @mon1tor_ua/72094)
Russian MoD claims 313 Ukrainian UAVs destroyed over Russian regions, Azov and Black Seas, indicating large-scale Ukrainian drone operations. (Source: @tass_agency/392549)

Ukrainian strike on Engels airbase (Saratov region) damaged/destroyed a Tu-95MS strategic bomber, per Zelensky; this base hosts nuclear-capable bombers launching cruise missiles. (Source: @UkraineNow/83744)
Russian strikes specifically targeted Ukrainian drone logistics: Fim Service (Flamingo components) and Fire Point (FP-1/FP-2 parts) in Kyiv region. (Source: @tass_agency/392558)

Massive drone traffic over central/northern Ukraine: 7 UAVs simultaneously entering Vyshhorod/Troyeshchyna/Brovary; multiple groups over Chernihiv, Poltava, Cherkasy, Kyiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Kirovohrad, Sumy, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia. (Source: @eRadarrua/108260, @eRadarrua/108284)

sections.threat_assessment: Russia's record 267-drone barrage demonstrates sustained capacity for mass UAV attacks despite Ukrainian interception rates near 87%. The targeting of Kyiv's drone logistics infrastructure (Flamingo, FP-1/FP-2 components) indicates a deliberate campaign to degrade Ukraine's own long-range strike capability. Simultaneously, Ukraine's successful Engels strike on a Tu-95MS shows growing asymmetric reach. The 90% destruction of retail warehousing creates cascading civilian supply risks, while the 30k/month mobilization requirement reveals critical manpower attrition. Russia's claimed 313 Ukrainian drone kills suggests Ukraine is also scaling deep strikes, creating a reciprocal escalation spiral.
sections.regional_response: European intelligence agencies assess no imminent Russian conventional threat to NATO or Baltic states per Bloomberg, contradicting some threat narratives. The EU Commission plans September enlargement reform abolishing national vetoes, potentially accelerating Ukraine's accession path. Poland explicitly rejects hosting nuclear weapons. The US State Department updated travel warnings urging citizens to avoid Ukraine due to missile/drone threats in non-frontline regions. Moldova's militarization is attributed to Western interests by Russian ambassador. These signals show Western cohesion on support but caution on direct escalation.
sections.intelligence_notes: The prevalent use of jet-powered Geran-4/5 variants from Orel and Donetsk airport signals Russian adaptation to Ukrainian air defenses, trading loiter time for speed/penetration. Drone transit corridors through Chernihiv-Poltava-Cherkasy-Kyiv and Bryansk-Chernihiv-Kyiv remain primary northern approaches. The Belarus overflight (Gomel) may indicate navigation failure or deliberate probing. Russian strike precision on specific drone component warehouses suggests actionable intelligence on Ukrainian UAV supply chains. The Nova Poshta warehouse destruction (60k books) illustrates collateral economic targeting. The Kovel mobilization resistance incident reflects domestic friction.
